extra_gate_fields.extra_gated_heading: Acknowledge license to accept the repository

interpretation: Both pinned LICENSE files permit sharing original and adapted material for noncommercial purposes. Public repo cards/metadata contain no additional prohibition on redistribution. Default HF access gating is not a new license restriction. This does not grant commercial use authorization.

tokenizer_provenance.infoxlm: Microsoft UniLM InfoXLM README explicitly identifies the same vocabulary/tokenizer/architecture as XLM-R; preserve Microsoft UniLM and Facebook fairseq MIT notices. HF infoxlm card lacks a license field; do not present that card alone as MIT evidence.
tokenizer_provenance.xlm_roberta_xl: facebook/xlm-roberta-xl model card declares MIT; preserve fairseq license.
